name: kat-platform-prism
title: Platform Prism
purpose: Answer each decision a content-addressed platform asks of its engineers, operators, security team and leaders, from conformance to rollout, by the app that models it, with every stated property proved in Lean.

promise.headline: Every platform decision, proved before it ships.
promise.detail: Seven decision apps in one verified guest: conformance verdicts, kappa-label checks, upload sessions, GC eviction, VM image admission, the rollout gate, and the router that sends each stakeholder's question to the decision that answers it.
